name: How long does it take to install a kitchen backsplash?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a kitchen backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen backsplash installation usually takes one to three days. Day one focuses on protecting countertops, removing any old tile or drywall damage, cutting tiles, and setting them in place with mortar or adhesive. The thin-set mortar requires roughly 24 hours to cure before applying grout. Day two or three involves grouting, wiping down haze, and applying flexible silicone caulk along the countertop seam. Complex layouts like herringbone, mosaic sheets, or hand-made natural stone tiles require more cutting and curing time, which can extend the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen backsplash installations take one to three days, allowing time for setting the tile, overnight mortar curing, grouting, and caulking.
